mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% over the prior month signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns remain positive in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 6 months signal weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both decline in prior 6 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline in prior 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a 5% decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month signals cooling consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where HOUST declines > 5% in 1 month during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 260.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates and suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns remain positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL > 260.0.

mechanism_narrative: In conjunction with monetary easing, a 3% monthly rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 3% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS falls < 0.05% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where RSAFS rises > 3% and FEDFUNDS falls < 0.05% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recovery, a 2% decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month signals manufacturing weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO declines > 2% in 1 month during early-cycle recovery.
